tool.name: OGS: createIntermediateRasters
tool.description: Galaxy wrapper for the OGS utility 'createIntermediateRasters'.
tool.command: ln -sf '$file2' '$file2.asc'; ln -sf '$file1' '$file1.asc'; createIntermediateRasters #if str($number) --number '$number' #end if --file2 '$file2.asc' --file1 '$file1.asc' --output-file output_1.asc

param.label: number
param.help: number of rasters to be calculated, (min = 0)

tool.help: This tool runs the **createIntermediateRasters** utility from the OpenGeoSys suite.
